description: Show the person their iHatePosting media box: they can upload an image or video from their own device, browse what is already in their library with every file previewable, see how much storage their plan leaves them, pick a file to use, or delete one. THIS IS THE ANSWER WHENEVER SOMEONE NAMES A FILE ON THEIR OWN COMPUTER — a path like C:\clips\launch.mp4 or ~/Movies/clip.mov is not something any tool here can read, and explaining that is not an answer: open this instead, in the same reply, and they pick the file from a picker right in the conversation. Also use it for anything they pasted or attached here. Do NOT try to send those bytes yourself — they would travel as your own output and arrive cut short. If the file already has a public address, use upload_media with `url` instead.
name: open_upload_widget
title: Show an upload box
